name: Villanueva del Arzobispo (Spain)
description: White field within a dark purple border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva del Arzobispo (a saint's figure on blue and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva del Arzobispo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva del Arzobispo arms — saint's figure on blue and lion on white
lion and cap of the crown of the arms
